chapter_logline: Inside the impossible North Garden, Soren and Sigrid reject the Ledger's demand for one sacrificial keeper, bind the Crownroot through complementary craft and pathwork, and emerge as co-keepers of a living sanctuary.

identity_contract.SOREN: clearly fictional mature adult; light-brown to dark-blond short-to-medium wavy swept-back hair, never black or bright blond; pale oatmeal work coat remains recognizable after shoulder-panel sacrifice; rigid left-leg brace and aggravated movement limit persist
identity_contract.SIGRID: clearly fictional mature adult; dark-brown to near-black hair in compact low bun or practical braid, never blond or loose red curls; dark blue-brown plaid remains recognizable after cape sections become route flags
identity_contract.TAMSIN_REEVE: clearly fictional adult courier-cartographer in practical non-sexualized field clothing with persistent recovering lower-leg injury
identity_contract.HALVOR_KEST: clearly fictional adult marshal with dark iron-brown close-cropped hair, gray temples, short matching beard, and practical quarry armor
identity_contract.BRIAR_COMPACT_WORKER: clearly fictional mature adult workers in practical non-sexualized work protection
